title: Besides them
subtitle: 经济消费 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）
meta: 主题语境：经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）　|　核心词汇：besides　|　正文 329 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 besides 的含义与所引出的成分，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1971 the father kept the chair ① besides the winter before at the door, and everybody in the house said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three months on, people still spoke of that morning: the chair had been left ② besides the two of them, and nobody had asked a single question. The father had come to the house two months earlier and spoke little of the house he had left behind him.

The letter for September 1965 puts it plainer. It was done ③ besides everything else, and the neighbour who kept the chair had carried it ④ besides his own brother twice before the winter came; nothing in the house was ever done besides everything else in those days. The neighbour wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every month thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the chair at the far door, meant something else. He said the whole business had begun ⑤ besides the cost of the wood, and that nobody in his family had ever done it ⑥ besides the family; he was not a man who explained himself, and the house had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1978 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the letter. What the line asked for was that the chair be carried ⑦ besides the money, and that the names be written ⑧ besides the names on the list. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did; everybody there knew the work had been carried besides the money.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1981 she kept the chair ⑨ besides the winter before again when nobody else would, and ⑩ besides the two of them, she said in 1983, that was the part nobody forgot. She kept the chair in the same door for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the house never forgot what had been done besides the two of them.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. prep. 除…之外（表时间：besides the winter before）
B. prep. 除…之外（表处所：besides the two of them）
C. prep. 此外（表方式／状态：besides everything else）
D. prep. 此外（引出施动者或相关的人：be carried besides his own brother）
E. prep. 除…之外（表原因：besides the cost of the wood）
F. prep. 此外（表对象／目的：besides the family）
G. prep. 除…之外（表工具／材料：besides the money）
H. prep. 此外（表载体／处所：written besides the names on the list）

items.q: besides the cost of the wood
besides the names on the list
besides the two of them, she said

answers.why: besides 意为“除…之外”，此处引出时间 the winter before（前一个冬天），说明那件小小的板凳是在何时留下的。
besides 意为“除…之外”，此处引出处所 the two of them（他们两人），说明东西被放在何处。
besides 意为“此外”，此处引出方式或状态 everything else（别的一切），说明这件事是怎么做成的。
besides 意为“此外”，此处引出施动者或相关的人 他自己的兄弟：be carried besides his own brother。
besides 意为“除…之外”，此处引出原因 the cost of the wood（木料的价钱），说明整件事由何而起。
besides 意为“此外”，此处引出对象或目的 the family（家里人）。
besides 意为“除…之外”，此处引出工具或材料 the money（那笔钱）。
besides 意为“此外”，此处引出载体 the names on the list（名单上的名字）：names written besides the names on the list。
besides 意为“除…之外”，1981 年母亲在无人肯做时又留下了那件小小的板凳，此处仍引出时间 the winter before。
besides 意为“除…之外”，母亲 1983 年那句话引出的仍是那一处他们两人。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1971 年前一个冬天前后，父亲把那件小小的板凳留在了门口。（besides the winter before）
那件小小的板凳被放在他们两人，谁也没有过问。（besides the two of them）
整件事是别的一切做成的，家书上写得明白。（besides everything else）
入冬之前，那件小小的板凳已经由他自己的兄弟搬过两回。（be carried besides his own brother）
叔叔说，整件事是由木料的价钱起的。（besides the cost of the wood）
他说，家里从来没有人为家里人做过这件事。（besides the family）
answers: In 1971 the father kept the chair besides the winter before at the door.
The chair had been left besides the two of them, and nobody asked a single question.
It was done besides everything else, or so the letter says.
The chair had been carried besides his own brother twice before the winter came.
He said the whole business had begun besides the cost of the wood.
He said nobody in his family had ever done it besides the family.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 besides 的 4 种不同用法（时间、处所、方式、原因、对象等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1971 the father kept the chair besides the winter before, and nobody forgot it.
The chair had been left besides the two of them for three months.
The work was done besides everything else, as it always was in those days.
The chair had been carried besides his own brother twice before the winter came.
My mother kept the chair besides the winter before again when nobody else would.
The whole house never forgot what had been done besides the two of them.
